evaluation.metric: relative bin excess over the L1 lower bound (fraction)

commands.notes: Run only in the extracted, SHA256-verified paper archive. Full API-funded search and SMAC HPO, not a smoke test.

notes: This task selects the frozen paper reproduction archive at Zenodo 14917719. The later GitHub implementation is retained only as a source reference.

The paper Zenodo archive was downloaded, its published MD5 verified, and source inspected. It provides the exact run_BP_HPO.py script and frozen library; see archive_execution. Commands run in the extracted paper archive; the current GitHub checkout is a separate, later implementation.

Archive README specifies Poetry1.7.1+ and Python3.10. Run poetry install, configure OPENAI_API_KEY, then poetry run python run_BP_HPO.py. Default model is gpt-4o-2024-05-13; verify availability before running.
The archived full search incurs API calls and substantial SMAC/benchmark compute. It creates experiment logs/results; paper result plotting is also available as plot_BP.py.
Source is pinned by the archive SHA256. Archived scripts start the full experiment immediately when invoked; use the command preview to inspect settings before executing.

Archived BP raw evaluator returns (mean bins used - mean L1 lower bound) / mean L1 lower bound: a dimensionless excess fraction to minimize, with no multiplication by 100. run_BP_HPO.py negates this value for maximization.
Paper Section4.1 instead defines mean_i(lb_i / n_i), a ratio to maximize. This differs from the archived score in formula and scale; both definitions are preserved separately.

evaluator_adapter.implementation_label: Original pinned LLM4AD task evaluator; MEoH's second objective (evaluation time) recorded but not optimized; original template program as seed
notes: The platform score is the negated mean cost (bins used, or tour length) over the evaluator's generated instances; higher is better.
MEoH ranks candidates on two objectives (score and evaluation time). The scalar score here is the first objective; evaluation_seconds is retained in the result for the second.
Instances are generated at evaluator construction with the platform's fixed seeds; they are not the paper's exact test instances.
Multi-objective optimization; preserve both objectives. Official paper links LLM4AD framework, whose current version may differ from original experiments.
